purpose: Daily maintenance of lifecycle meta labels: meta:has-pr from linked PRs (sync-pr-labels.js) and meta:stale for inactive issues (manage-stale-issues.js).

jobs.summary: Checkout, setup Node, npm ci; on schedule run both scripts in apply mode (30-day threshold); on dispatch run them in dry-run or apply mode according to dryRun.

failure_points.issue: Scheduled at 03:00 UTC, the '3am UTC' collision given as an archival reason.
dryRun is free text; any value other than exactly 'true' or 'false' skips every step and the run still reports success.
Scheduled stale detection hard-codes --days 30 rather than a shared setting.
The manifest describes it as 'Label schema synchronization', but it does not sync label definitions; the name is misleading.

overlaps_with: issue-labeling-automation.yml (02:00) and label-audit-report.yml (04:00) in the same schedule cluster
